subject: Invoice ingest guidelines and filename/subject conventions for Halcyon Systems onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@halcyon-systems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@halcyon-systems.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission options and a few template questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier. We're ready to go live with Redwood but have a couple of operational items to confirm before we submit our first invoice: 

1) Preferred channel: You mentioned a vendor portal and email fallback. Can you confirm which you prefer for Halcyon initial invoices vs ongoing?

2) File format: Do you accept CSV as a primary payload (one row per line item) or do you require PDF invoices? If CSV, what encoding and column order do you expect?

3) Multi-PO invoices: We sometimes ship under multiple POs and prefer to send a single invoice with multiple PO line references. Is that supported, and how do you want PO numbers represented?

4) VAT / tax: For our EU shipments we need to include VAT lines. Do you have a separate tax_amount column or do you expect tax rolled into total_amount?

5) Filename & subject token: Our AR system relies on an invoice subject token to auto-route. Do you have a preferred filename pattern and email subject convention for fallback emails?

6) Acknowledgement SLA: If we use the portal, how quickly will Redwood send an invoice acknowledgement/receipt?

I'm attaching a tiny sample CSV row from our billing export to show what we typically send (invoice_sample_row.csv). If easier, happy to fill any vendor onboarding form first — please point me to it.

Quick background: Halcyon Systems (vendor) — contact for AR is accounts@halcyon-systems.com.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Billing Lead, Halcyon Systems
attachments: invoice_sample_row.csv (CSV)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@halcyon-systems.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options and a few template questions

Hi Elena — great to hear. Quick answers and a proposed template so your AR system can map cleanly into our AP pipeline. TL;DR: portal preferred, email allowed as fallback with strict subject/filename conventions.

Preferred channel
- Vendor Portal (preferred): secure upload, idempotency, automatic acks. Use the vendor onboarding link below to register and push your invoices.
- Email fallback: send to invoices@redwood.com and include the subject token (see pattern). Email is slower and requires human validation for ambiguous PO matches.

Required fields (CSV single-line-per-invoice-line)
- vendor_id (our assigned vendor id after onboarding)
- vendor_name
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- invoice_number
- po_number (required if invoice is against a PO)
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal)
- line_total (decimal)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- remit_to (bank id or billing address id)
- contact_email

Multi-PO handling
- Single CSV file may contain lines for multiple PO_numbers. Each row should include po_number column. Our ingestion will group lines by invoice_number and validate PO totals. If you prefer a single invoice header with multiple PO references, keep invoice_number constant across those rows and include separate po_number values per row.

VAT / tax
- Please provide tax_amount as a separate column. We do not assume tax; tax must be explicit per line. We support VAT flags in an additional column 'tax_class' if needed.

Filename and subject conventions (email fallback)
- Filename: HALCYON-{PO or INV}-{invoice_number}.{pdf|csv}  e.g. HALCYON-PO7754-INV1002.pdf or HALCYON-INV1002.csv
- Email subject token: [INV:HALCYON:PO:7754:INV1002]  — include a single token anywhere in the subject and we will auto-route. Example subject: "Invoice submission [INV:HALCYON:PO:7754:INV1002]"

Acknowledgement SLA
- Portal uploads: automatic ack within 1 hour (usually immediate); email ack within 24 hours for processed uploads.

Onboarding form
- Please complete: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cVendorOnboardForm — once submitted we will return a vendor_id and enable portal uploads.

I've attached a one-line sample CSV and a short example row below. If you want, I can generate a one-off test ingestion for the first invoice so you can validate mapping.

Sample CSV row (header row omitted for clarity)
HALCYON,Halcyon Systems,2027-05-28,INV1002,PO7754,Widget A,10,12.50,2.50,127.50,USD,ACCT-5467,accounts@halcyon-systems.com

Next steps
- Elena: complete onboarding form and tell us if you want a test ingestion
- Jordan/Marissa: we'll provision vendor_id and enable portal

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: invoice_sample_row.csv (CSV)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@halcyon-systems.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options and a few template questions

Thanks, Jordan and Elena — quick finance notes so expectations are aligned: 

- PO requirement: our AP team requires a valid po_number on every invoice line for PO-driven spend. If a line is not tied to a PO, we need a short description and approver email.
- Multi-PO invoices: allowed, but our payment system will split payment across the POs; ensure each line references the correct PO number.
- VAT handling: for US-headquartered Redwood payments, VAT should be shown separately. For EU entities we may require additional VAT documentation; please indicate tax_country and tax_id in the CSV if relevant.
- Remit instructions: please include explicit remit_to bank identifier or check remittance address in the remit_to column to avoid delays.

I'm attaching the portal quickstart we share with partners so you can see where fields map in our intake UI. Once Jordan confirms vendor_id we'll run a single-file test ingestion for Halcyon.

Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the clarity. We'll: 1) fill the onboarding form today, 2) change our export to emit the exact header/columns you listed for the CSV, and 3) upload the first invoice to the portal once vendor_id is provisioned.

I've attached a PDF copy of the invoice we plan to send after onboarding (HAL-PO7754_INV-1002.pdf). Please confirm you'll send the portal ack within 1 hour of upload so our AR queue can be cleared. If you prefer we can also email the same file to invoices@redwood.com with the subject token for a cross-check.

Thanks — Elena
